title: Let an application call the Entra Policy Suite API (or stop it)
purpose: Assigns the registration's app role EPS.Api.Call to the Invardia Support app (-SupportApp, on request only) or to one of your own programs (-AppId), or removes it (-Remove). It also makes sure the registration has what the API for applications needs: the app role, the idtyp claim, v2 tokens, assignment required. Every change is read back.
whenToRun: When you ask Invardia to fix support tickets for you (-SupportApp), or when a program of yours should read or change Entra Policy Suite settings by code (-AppId; then a SuperAdmin adds it under Administration > Settings > Security > API applications). After an update that says the registration misses the API for applications.

runAs.name: Application Administrator (or Cloud Application Administrator)
runAs.why: changes the Entra Policy Suite registration and assigns its app role to an application

runAs.name: Reader
runAs.scope: the Entra Policy Suite resource group

changes.object: the Entra Policy Suite app registration
changes.permission: the app role EPS.Api.Call (applications only), the access token claim idtyp, v2 tokens
changes.why: only an application assigned this role gets a token for the API, and the token proves it is an application
changes.undo: not needed: the role does nothing until an application is assigned it

changes.object: an app role assignment of EPS.Api.Call to the application
changes.scope: the Entra Policy Suite enterprise application
changes.why: layer 1 of the two: the application may call the API at all; what it may do there is Entra Policy Suite's own list

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription Entra Policy Suite is installed in

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: the install's resource group (found by itself when there is one)

parameters.name: SupportApp
parameters.help: the Invardia Support app, found by its InvardiaSupport tag (exactly one)

parameters.name: AppId
parameters.help: the app id of your own program (instead of -SupportApp)

readsOnly: Graph: the registration, its enterprise application and its app role assignments, the tagged Support app
whatIf: What is there and what would be set, assigned or removed; nothing is changed.
